diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~11% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.212), which favours a robust combination.
